text:
yvonne: Quick 10-min sync 
Goal: a lightweight, hyper-segmented newsletter + drip to support the benchmark launch and webinar. Priority: high-quality demo clicks and webinar attendance from paid trials + engaged subscribers. Send window next Wed-Fri. :calendar: 
otto: Proposal: 3-path cadence by intent signal: 1) Trial-Active mini-drip (3 emails) 2) Engaged-Subscriber nurture (3 emails) 3) Cold-Subscriber teaser (2 emails). Keep register-first CTA everywhere.
mira: Creative constraints: single hero (1200x628) + a compact mobile crop (600x300). Also make a 1-page PDF summary for enterprise outreach. I can have hero + PDF by Tue noon.
yvonne: Segmentation rules (concise):
- trial_active: signup_date <= 90d AND api_calls_last_14d > 5 AND tag != 'enterprise-dnc'
- engaged_sub: subscribed=true AND opens_last_30d >= 2 AND clicked_docs_last_60d > 0
- cold_sub: subscribed=true AND opens_last_60d <= 1
Exclude: unsubscribed, gdpr_dnc, enterprise_do_not_contact, recent_webinar_attendee_180d.
otto: Deliverability notes: send via SendGrid pool "bench-hyper-1". Throttles: trial_active 600/min, engaged_sub 1k/min, cold_sub 450/min. Use prefix suppression to avoid duplicates if someone maps to multiple segments same day. ops-bot: status?
deliver-bot: SendGrid pool "bench-hyper-1" warmness 86%, projected warm in 28h.
kevin: Retry policy: exponential backoff for 5xx, max_retries=5. Daily recipient cap for campaign = 2 sends. Also enable link-preserve so CRM gets original utm params.
mira: Subject line candidates (short + distinct):
- "New benchmark: realistic per-token economics"
- "How teams cut per-token cost without trading latency"
- "Join our bench walkthrough + live Q&A"
Preheaders: "RSVP for live demo" / "Bench highlights + actionable tips"
yvonne: Personalization plan: trial_active -> first-line: "Saw you trying the API 1 here's how teams cut per-token cost." Engaged_sub -> reference docs they clicked: "Since you read our guide on batching..." Cold -> generic value lead: "New benchmark: what it means for inference costs." 50/50 split test for personalization vs generic on trial_active.
otto: A/B test matrix summary: trial_active: subject A/B x first-line personal/generic = 4 cells (sample cap 3k/cell). engaged_sub: subject A/B = 2 cells. cold_sub: subject A only (control) to limit sends. All tests tagged with utm_campaign=bench_hyper_q2 & utm_content=cellX.
kevin: Automation mapping: registrants -> calendar invite + 24h and 1h reminders. Registrants get immediate bench_download link. Non-attendees -> post-webinar bench_download + demo CTA. Demo clicks create CRM lead + tag 'bench_interest'.
yvonne: Copy location: https://docs.redwood.ai/mkt/bench/hyperseg/copy-drafts. Assets: /marketing/assets/bench_hyper/
mira: I'll include alt-text and mobile-safe crops. Also include a plain-text fallback for enterprise sends.
kevin: QA + seeds: internal seeds = yvonne, otto, mira, aj, kevin + 6 external test addresses. QA checklist: images render, calendar .ics attaches, unsubscribe functional, link tracking intact across Gmail/Outlook/iOS Mail.
aj: Approvals: product (aj), legal (legal@redwood.ai), deliverability (kevin). Need approvals by Mon 3pm PT to hit Wed. Audience export required from Data by Tue 10am PT.
otto: Small infra note: set throttle backoff if warmness <80% before first send, and pause campaign if bounce rate spikes >3%.
yvonne: Anything blocking?
mira: waiting on final audience export.
kevin: none from deliverability if audience is clean.
aj: I'll QA audience Tue morning.
yvonne: Great. Reconvene Mon after signoffs. Thanks team :sparkles:
